title: Grand-Chukuchuku — five-character turnaround set v1
author: Nkeh Nkengzincho (Zino)
age_scope: Proposed later-secondary models, approximately 14–15; exact ages and training onset open
source: Author-supplied traits with proposed animation faces, clothes and age variants; native-generated images
wardrobe_rule: Daytime school uniform is sky-blue/navy. Professional School night readers wear house/casual clothes; some dress to impress. No students wear uniforms at night.

characters.name: Zino
characters.author_traits: Handsome; clean fades. Gifted, witty and quick-footed.
characters.design: Crisp low fade with a curly top; slim athletic teenage silhouette. Proposed night outfit: burgundy T-shirt, charcoal casual trousers and dark sneakers.

characters.name: Luc
characters.author_traits: Muscular build, big hands, big ears and high flat-top. Homemade evening weights; small Bible.
characters.design: Strong adolescent shoulders and larger hands/ears. Proposed night outfit: mustard T-shirt, loose navy casual trousers and dark sneakers. Training onset remains open.

characters.name: Gideon / Giddy
characters.author_traits: Large head and nose, small front-tooth gap, W-shaped hairline and fuller almost-afro hair.
characters.design: The front view's small smile reveals the gap. Proposed night outfit: forest-green polo, dark-brown casual trousers and worn sneakers. Camera bag remains his scene prop.

characters.name: Mirabel
characters.author_traits: Black Cameroonian girl with low-cut natural hair; beautiful, slim build. Zino's maths friend from Form Three.
characters.design: Proposed angular oval face, straight brows, precise low-crop texture, teal/cream top, charcoal straight trousers and dark flats. Slim vertical outline; not Elianne.

characters.name: Lizzy
characters.author_traits: Black Cameroonian girl with low-cut natural hair and pretty face; Zino's school girlfriend, breakup in Form Three.
characters.design: Proposed rounder face, arched brows, short natural crop, loose rose top, full mustard A-line skirt and cream flats. Rounded face and triangular garment outline; natural school-age proportions.
